In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], towards the end of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] march upon the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] within the Temple had been nearly exterminated. At this point, '''three Jedi Masters''' took command of the remaining Jedi and [[Temple Security Force]] personnel. The [[Unidentified Jedi Master 1|trio]] [[Unidentified Jedi Master 2|of]] [[Unidentified Jedi Master 3|Jedi]] lead them through one last rally against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] army, but it proved unsuccessful and all three were then killed by Vader's [[501st Legion/Legends|force]].<ref name="SWBII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The three Jedi Masters are killed by the player in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', but the means of their execution is not standardized. They can be killed either as Vader or a clone trooper at the whim of the player.<ref name="SWBII" />
